title: Understanding Residuals
text: Think about what the residuals represent in an OLS model. They are the differences between the actual outcomes and the predicted outcomes. What does it mean for these residuals in relation to the design matrix X?

title: Orthogonality in OLS
text: In the context of OLS, the residuals are orthogonal to the columns of the design matrix X. This means that the dot product of the residuals with any column of X is zero. How does this relate to the concept of orthogonality?
